the role of HPS proteins in the melanization of melannocytes.

the HPS-1 and HPS-3 proteins are required for the proper sorting of melanocyte-specific vesicles.

the HPS3 gene product is involved in trafficking of a specific set of melanocyte-specific vesicles and that the trafficking defect is not as severe as in HPS1.

The main takeaway from our work is that
HPS-3 is a relatively mild form of HPS, with minimal cutaneous depigmentation, but that there are still abnormalities in melanin biosynthesis in HPS- 3.
